name: Narendra Modi
description: Head of the Government of India, leader of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

name: Droupadi Murmu
description: Head of State of India, holding the highest constitutional office.

name: Nirmala Sitharaman
description: Heads the Ministry of Finance, responsible for budget, taxation, and economic policy.

name: Amit Shah
description: Heads the Ministry of Home Affairs, responsible for internal security and law and order.

name: Subrahmanyam Jaishankar
description: Heads the Ministry of External Affairs, overseeing India's foreign policy and diplomacy.

name: Rajnath Singh
description: Heads the Ministry of Defence, overseeing national security and the armed forces.

name: Piyush Goyal
description: Heads the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, overseeing trade policy and exports.

name: Dhankhar
description: Serves as Vice President and ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

name: Om Birla
description: Presides over the proceedings of the Lok Sabha, the lower house of Indian Parliament.

name: Ashwini Vaishnaw
description: Heads the Ministry of Railways and Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
